description_expanded: ABOUT SUMMER TOWNE 1 at Pier Park: Welcome to SummerTowne 1, a beautiful 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath vacation home that sleeps 7, perfectly situated just steps from the famous white sand beaches of the Emerald Coast. Located in a charming community with a pool, this home offers the ideal setting for a memorable beach getaway. Enjoy the soothing sounds of the ocean right from your master bedroom balcony or take a short walk to experience the stunning Gulf views firsthand. With its prime location across from the beach, just 3 minutes from Pier Park, and a 10-minute drive to 30A, SummerTowne 1 provides easy access to the best of the Emerald Coast. This two-story home features both bedrooms on the second floor, including a king-master ensuite with breathtaking ocean views and a single twin pull out mattress. The guest bedroom is a cozy queen ensuite, ensuring comfort and privacy for all. The first floor offers an open living space with a fully equipped kitchen, a dining area, and a living room with a queen sleeper sofa, perfect for relaxing after a day of fun in the sun. After enjoying the beach or the community pool, rinse off in the outdoor shower before unwinding on the balcony. SummerTowne 1 is the perfect spot to create lasting memories on your next family vacation or winter getaway. Experience the ultimate Emerald Coast retreat in this well-appointed home, where every detail is designed for your comfort and enjoyment. ABOUT THE AREA: The West End of Panama City Beach, Florida, is known for its serene and laid-back atmosphere, offering a more secluded and tranquil experience compared to the bustling areas in the heart of Panama City Beach. This area is characterized by its pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, and picturesque natural beauty. Visitors to the West End can enjoy a more peaceful beach experience with fewer crowds, perfect for relaxation and unwinding. The West End of Panama City Beach is home to a variety of charming beachfront communities, upscale resorts, and vacation rental properties, offering visitors a range of accommodation options to suit their preferences. From luxury beachfront condos to cozy beach cottages, there are plenty of choices for accommodations in this area. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the West End's proximity to natural attractions such as Camp Helen State Park and Conservation Park, where they can explore hiking and biking trails, spot local wildlife, and enjoy the beauty of the unique coastal landscape. Water sports enthusiasts can partake in activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling in the calm waters of the Gulf. For those seeking dining and entertainment options, the West End of Panama City Beach offers a selection of waterfront restaurants, beach bars, and cafes serving up fresh seafood and local cuisine. Visitors can also explore nearby shopping areas, art galleries, and cultural attractions in the surrounding area. Overall, the West End of Panama City Beach is a hidden gem for those looking for a more peaceful and scenic beach experience, away from the hustle and bustle of the busier tourist areas, while still providing easy access to all the amenities and attractions that make Panama City Beach a sought-after destination on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Public Beach Access #60 PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Gulf Views * Steps from the Beach * Community Pool PARKING: * Free Parking for up to 2 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * If you choose to bring your dog(s), there is an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $250 per dog. The fee is to be charged after reservation confirmation. * There is no smoking inside or outside while on the property. * All reservations are non-refundable, we strongly encourage adding travel insurance to your reservation so that you are covered. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. *Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to the properties we manage may go under construction without being notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
